title: SSRF via Profile Image URL (Server-Side Request Forgery)
proof: POST /profile/image/url with imageUrl=http://127.0.0.1:3011/rest/admin/application-configuration → server stored URL + dynamically updated CSP img-src + profileImage changed from URL to local file assets/public/images/uploads/24.jpg, proving server-side fetch. The internal /rest/admin/application-configuration endpoint returns full app config including OAuth clientId, authorized redirect URIs, challenge config, and product data.
